scope: Scene preparation; solver setup including shader compilation, allocation and initial state; recorder setup; solve; output. Excludes process startup, gpu-slot waiting and this receipt write. Setup subphases are nested host elapsed intervals: command queue, shader library, eager pipelines, buffers/texture, initial uniform state and scenario load. Library/pipeline phases may include driver cache lookup or compilation; they are not pure compiler time. Lazy setup during later phases remains there. Optional initial-state diagnostic copying is inside total time but outside these component phases.
